title: Server patching
desc: Check for and apply OS package updates (apt, dnf, yum, apk). Reboots are never automatic.
upToDate: Your server is up to date.
checkFailed: The update check couldn't complete — a package repository may be unreachable or misconfigured. This is not the same as being up to date.
unsupported: Automatic patching needs one of apt, dnf, yum or apk on the server.
rebootRequired: A reboot is required to finish applying updates.
